title: HDF System Primitives
description: Types for describing system architecture, authorization boundaries, and components.

Authorization_Status.description: Authorization to Operate (ATO) status for the system.
Authorization_Status.title: Authorization Status

baselineRef.description: Name of the baseline this override applies to. If omitted, applies to all baselines that define this input.

inputName.description: Name of the input being overridden. Must match an Input.name in the referenced baseline.

value.description: The overridden value. Should match the type of the original input.

justification.description: Rationale for why this override is needed.

approvedBy.description: Identity of the person or system that approved this override.

Input_Override.description: An override of a baseline input value for a specific component. Enables system-specific tailoring of baseline parameters.
Input_Override.title: Input Override

Target_Selector.description: A label selector that matches targets by label key-value pairs. All specified labels must match (AND logic). Example: { "labels.component": "WebTier" } matches targets with labels.component = "WebTier".
Target_Selector.title: Target Selector

description.description: Description of this component's role in the system.

targetSelector.description: Label selector to match targets belonging to this component. Targets with matching labels are automatically included.

baselineRefs.description: Names of baselines that apply to this component's targets.

inputOverrides.description: System-specific overrides for baseline input values.

sbomRef.description: URI to a CycloneDX or SPDX SBOM document for this component.

sbomFormat.description: Format of the referenced SBOM document.

examples.name: WebTier
examples.description: RHEL 9 web servers running the portal

inputOverrides.justification: Admin team needs 5 sessions for shift handoff

Component.description: A logical component within a system's authorization boundary. Components match targets via label selectors and reference the baselines that apply to them.
Component.title: Component

controlId.description: The control identifier (e.g., 'SC-7', 'AC-2 (1)'). Must match a NIST tag in a baseline requirement's tags.

designation.description: NIST SP 800-53 control designation. 'common': fully provided by another component or system. 'system-specific': implemented by the inheriting component(s) only. 'hybrid': shared responsibility between provider and inheritor.

providedBy.description: componentId of a local component that provides this control. Omit when the provider is an external system.

systemRef.description: Reference to another hdf-system document whose component provides this control. Use when the provider is in a different system. Omit when the provider is local.

inheritedBy.description: componentIds that inherit this control. If omitted, all components in the system inherit it.

description.description: Justification for this designation — who provides the control, why it's inherited, and any relevant authorization references.

examples.description: User identification and authentication provided by Keycloak SSO via SAML 2.0.
Physical access authorizations provided by AWS GovCloud per FedRAMP High authorization.

Control_Designation.description: Declares a control's designation within a system — whether it is common (provided by another component or system), system-specific (implemented locally), or hybrid (shared responsibility). Maps to NIST SP 800-53 Appendix C control designations and OSCAL SSP by-component provided/inherited semantics.
Control_Designation.title: Control Designation

externalSystem.description: Name or identifier of the external system.

direction.description: Data flow direction relative to this system.

description.description: Description of the interconnection's purpose and data exchanged.

securityMeasures.description: Security controls applied to this interconnection.

Interconnection.description: A connection between this system and an external system that crosses the authorization boundary.
Interconnection.title: Interconnection
